title: File System Operations in Shell
title_vi: Kiểm Tra và Thao Tác Hệ Thống Tệp Bằng Script
overview: Test file existence (-f), directory existence (-d), permissions (-r, -w, -x), and size (-s).

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành các khái niệm shell bên dưới. Hướng dẫn được biên soạn lại; yêu cầu chức năng theo bài công khai được liên kết.

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/test_file.txt')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['This is a test file for our lab.']), 'Required concepts missing'
if False: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Testing File Existence
sections.content:
Create file_exists.sh using -e; run before/after renaming test_file.txt to non_existent.txt.

`~/project/file_exists.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
filename="test_file.txt"
if [ -e "$filename" ]; then echo "$filename exists"; else echo "$filename does not exist"; fi
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/file_exists.sh
~/project/file_exists.sh 
```

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/file_exists.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['-e']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in []),result.stdout
    (work/'test_file.txt').write_text('sample')
    assert 'test_file.txt exists' in execute([str(p)]).stdout
    (work/'test_file.txt').unlink()
    assert 'test_file.txt does not exist' in execute([str(p)]).stdout
LABEX_CHECK


import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/file_readable.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['-r']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in

        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))

    def execute(arguments, data=''):

    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in []),result.stdout
    q=work/'test_file.txt'
